description: This file defines an interface 'AuthParamsInterface' within the OrangeHRM Authentication module. It specifies method signatures for retrieving user credentials and authentication attributes, serving as a contract for implementing classes that will handle authentication parameters.

classes.name: AuthParamsInterface
classes.description: A PHP interface defining the contract for authentication parameters, including methods to retrieve user credentials and attribute bags.

methods.name: getCredential
methods.description: Returns the user credentials, if available, implementing UserCredentialInterface.

methods.name: getAttributeBag
methods.description: Returns the attribute bag associated with the authentication, implementing AuthAttributeBagInterface.
